scope: Development SARIF validation only; no runtime engine, report schema, rules or package dependency changed. Historical release evidence remains untouched.

observedFailure.probe: Phase-one SARIF with version replaced by invalid-version, validated against the exact official schema
observedFailure.reportedError: JSON1019: version does not match the allowed 2.1.0 enum
observedFailure.implication: The previous process-exit-only check could accept a report with validation errors. No historical invalid report is established by this probe.

timeoutInvestigation.observed: An unchanged 210000ms Multitool timeout occurred; a later run showed an outbound SYN_SENT connection and DNS cache correspondence to docs.oasis-open.org while making little CPU progress.
timeoutInvestigation.inference: Repeated remote schema resolution is a plausible stall source, not proven as the exclusive cause of the timeout.
timeoutInvestigation.correction: Download the exact referenced official schema once through a bounded checksum-pinned request and pass its local path explicitly to every Multitool invocation. Do not use the different bundled schema or skip validation on download failure.

negativeControls.mutation: Set a result.ruleIndex outside the rule array

regressionCoverage.assertion: Positive validation requires process success and no reported error. Negative controls require process completion and an explicit expected validation error; timeout, process failure and missing diagnostics never qualify.
